derived_from: calib_v5 sweep row lambda=1.0 (fusion_results_rgb_test_conf0.20.json), calibrated on 11 diverse sequences at 95% conditional recall
why_not_the_sweep_best: The sweep's best row (lambda=2.0, tau=0.002) is degenerate: at tau=0.002 virtually every proposal passes, so the verifier stage filters nothing. lambda=1.0 weighs both modalities equally (principled Bayesian log-odds fusion) and its tau=0.034 achieves the same true F1 on the v5 blind set (89.0%) while still rejecting proposals that both verifiers score low.
why_not_v4_pooled: The v4 pooled config (lambda=0.75, tau=0.491) was calibrated on v3-era proposals. v5 event-YOLO proposals are much cleaner, so tau=0.491 over-rejects: true recall drops 79.6% vs 82.3% on the 10-sequence v5 blind set (true F1 87.6% vs 89.0%). A high tau also vetoes RGB-sourced hybrid catches whose event crop is empty (hovering drone: event verifier is low by construction).
